title: Agentic Compatibility Dropshipping — Photo → Exact Part → One-Click Buy
description: Customer takes picture of broken component. System identifies exact part, validates compatibility, finds cheapest supplier relative to location, one-click buy via Shopify. We normalize supplier data that's shit.

customer_flow: Customer takes photo of broken part
Shows: 'Yes — this is Bosch part 00631200. It fits SMS46MI08E. £71.40 delivered tomorrow.'

supplier_normalization.problem: Suppliers have: warehouse, purchasing relationships, stock, packing, courier contracts. They're terrible at: titles, images, structured compatibility, GTIN/MPN normalization, model mappings, supersessions, product discovery, customer support, machine-readable stock, agentic checkout.
supplier_normalization.solution: We fix the bad half. Margin = compensation for solving information entropy.

dropship_flow: Customer buys from our Shopify store
Order routes to cheapest supplier relative to location

component_identification.component_type: string (pump, valve, pcb, sensor, bearing, filter, seal)
